evidence_items.explanation: The review identifies substantial uncertainty in earlier effectiveness and safety evidence. It does not establish that every technology available in February 2023 lacked persistent emotional alignment.

evidence_items.publisher: Internet Interventions, abstract hosted by PubMed
evidence_items.explanation: This 16-week randomized study reported depression and therapeutic-alliance benefits, while anxiety improvement was less persistent. It provides relevant contrary evidence to a blanket dismissal of sustained help, but does not test reliable alignment to individual emotional needs.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved evaluation directly measures dependable, persistent alignment to individual emotional needs.
The literature reviewed is insufficient to establish the universal negative across all technologies known by February 22, 2023.
Longitudinal therapeutic benefits do not establish a general alignment capability, and limited evidence does not prove its absence.
